\section{Professional Profile}
Cybersecurity professional working across security engineering, SOC operations, cloud security and digital product delivery in regulated financial services. Lead an eight-member SOC and direct security architecture at Access Bank Ghana, translating business priorities and regulatory expectations into practical controls. Combine hands-on technical delivery with executive reporting, team development and community education.
